Hermes Investment Management LTD Stake in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Trimmed by $231.17 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Hermes Investment Management Ltd decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 40.41% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hermes Investment Management Ltd sold 1.34 million shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.98M shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $341.75M, down from 3.33 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hermes Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $501.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $1.02 $195. About 14.24M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Hermes Investment Management Ltd, which manages about $20.91 billion and $6.98B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Credicorp Ltd (NYSE:BAP) by 83,727 shares to 406,204 shares, valued at $84.26M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Rpm Intl Inc (NYSE:RPM) by 58,236 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.20M shares, and has risen its stake in Canadian Natl Ry Co (NYSE:CNI).
Analysts await Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) to report earnings on August, 16. They expect $1.16 EPS, up 23.40 % or $0.22 from last year’s $0.94 per share. BABA’s profit will be $2.98 billion for 42.03 P/E if the $1.16 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.54 actual EPS reported by Alibaba Group Holding Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 114.81 % EPS growth.
